title: Trustless Log Index #2, February 3, 2026
summary: Simplified log index proposal: ordered event lists (blocks, txs, logs) tree-hashed by type then value Index tables generated per block or merged from multiple blocks; never modified after creation Single block tables added instantly to headers; larger tables added with delay for async processing Tables hashed into simple chain; small tables (last ~80 blocks) required for initialization Bigger tables (>64 blocks) gene
